app.name: Homestretch
app.partner: Habitat for Humanity of Orange County

welcome.title: See how close you are to a Habitat home, and exactly what to do next.
welcome.sub: Takes about 4 minutes. Nothing is sent to a credit bureau.

flow.inlineReq: Habitat OC requires this. You can keep going, and staff can talk through options with you.

household.title: Tell us about your household
household.sizeHelp: Everyone who will live in the home, including you.
household.inOC: Do you live or work in Orange County?
household.resident: Is everyone applying a US citizen or permanent resident?

income.title: What does your household earn?
income.grossHelp: Before taxes. Include tips and overtime if steady.
income.otherHelp: Child support, a second job, or benefits.
income.scanBody: We read the numbers and fill this in for you. You can edit anything.
income.required: Enter your monthly income to continue.

housing.title: Where you live now
housing.rentHelp: What your household pays, not including utilities.
housing.unsafe: The home has unsafe or unhealthy conditions
housing.unsafeHelp: Mold, broken heat, pests, or repairs the landlord won't make.
housing.required: Enter your rent to continue. Enter 0 if you don't pay rent.

money.title: Your money picture
money.debtsHelp: Leave blank what you don't have.
money.collectionHelp: Debts sent to a collection agency. Enter what you owe.
money.savings: Savings you could put toward a home
money.savingsHelp: Checking, savings, and cash you could set aside.
money.creditHelp: Your best guess is fine. We don't check your credit.
money.creditRequired: Choose how your credit looks to continue.
money.savingsRequired: Enter your savings to continue. Enter 0 if none yet.
money.statementTitle: Upload a bank statement for a sharper plan
money.statementBody: Optional. Your file is used once to fill in this form and is not stored.
